# Stage 3 — Scouting Capacity and Financial Illustration

A team may not have enough scouting hours to review every prospect in detail. We simulate reviewing the highest-scored **25% of future-year combine prospects** and compare how many eventually drafted prospects appear on each shortlist. A no-model random shortlist has an expected drafted count equal to the overall draft rate times the number reviewed. The financial values below are **explicit assumptions, not observed NFL scouting costs**. Selection in the actual draft is a proxy for being on other teams' draft radar, not proof a prospect becomes a good professional player.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
dir.create("objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
base_probs <- readRDS("objects/base_probs.rds")
blend_prob <- readRDS("objects/blend_prob.rds")
test_y <- readRDS("objects/test_y.rds")
test_data <- readRDS("objects/test_data.rds")
```

```{r analysis}
# Rank using one consistent holdout; never use draft_round as a feature.
scoring <- data.frame(base_probs, ProbabilityBlend = blend_prob)
truth <- as.integer(test_y == "Drafted")
n <- length(truth)
review_share <- 0.25
review_slots <- max(1L, floor(n * review_share))
expected_random <- review_slots * mean(truth)

# Hours and dollars are scenarios only: 3 hours per film review at $65/hour.
hours_per_review <- 3
cost_per_hour <- 65
cost_per_review <- hours_per_review * cost_per_hour
full_review_cost <- n * cost_per_review
shortlist_cost <- review_slots * cost_per_review

# Each model selects the same number of prospects; only the ordering changes.
scouting_table <- data.frame(Model = names(scoring),
                             Reviewed = review_slots,
                             DraftedOnShortlist = NA_integer_,
                             Precision = NA_real_, Recall = NA_real_,
                             LiftOverRandom = NA_real_)
for (i in seq_len(ncol(scoring))) {
  # Tie-break on original row order so the shortlist is reproducible.
  ordered <- order(-scoring[[i]], seq_len(n))
  chosen <- ordered[seq_len(review_slots)]
  found <- sum(truth[chosen])
  scouting_table$DraftedOnShortlist[i] <- found
  scouting_table$Precision[i] <- found / review_slots
  scouting_table$Recall[i] <- found / sum(truth)
  scouting_table$LiftOverRandom[i] <- (found / review_slots) / mean(truth)
}
print(scouting_table)
cat("All-player review cost (assumed): $", full_review_cost, "\n", sep = "")
cat("25% shortlist review cost (assumed): $", shortlist_cost, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Expected drafted prospects in a random shortlist:", round(expected_random, 1), "\n")

# Test capacity sensitivity without choosing a new model based on these results.
capacity_table <- data.frame()
for (share in c(0.10, 0.25, 0.40)) {
  slots <- max(1L, floor(n * share))
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(scoring))) {
    chosen <- order(-scoring[[i]], seq_len(n))[seq_len(slots)]
    capacity_table <- rbind(capacity_table,
      data.frame(Share = share, Model = names(scoring)[i], Reviewed = slots,
                 DraftedFound = sum(truth[chosen]),
                 ExpectedRandom = slots * mean(truth),
                 ReviewCost = slots * cost_per_review))
  }
}
print(capacity_table)

```

```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(scouting_table, "objects/scouting_table.rds")
saveRDS(capacity_table, "objects/capacity_table.rds")
saveRDS(review_slots, "objects/review_slots.rds")
saveRDS(expected_random, "objects/expected_random.rds")
saveRDS(full_review_cost, "objects/full_review_cost.rds")
saveRDS(shortlist_cost, "objects/shortlist_cost.rds")
saveRDS(cost_per_review, "objects/cost_per_review.rds")
```
